text:
maya: quick q — deploying an edge function on Deno Deploy and our auth started failing, 401s on every request. we set REDWOOD_KEY via the project secrets UI. any obvious hosting gotchas?

glen: did you log the value inside the runtime? Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') — sometimes providers wrap with quotes or add newline.

sam: +1. try echoing it server-side, e.g. `console.log(JSON.stringify(Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY')))` to reveal hidden chars. :eyes: 

jess: also check the header format you're sending. for bearer: `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>`. for basic auth it's `Authorization: Basic <base64(user:pass)>`. easy to mix those up.

maya: thanks — we're using a service-to-service key (no user:pass). code is `fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: 'Basic ' + btoa(key) } })` because of copy/paste from an old example. oops.

glen: ah yeah that's the bug. if it's an API key you should use Bearer. Basic wraps the token as username (or username:password) which the backend won't accept. swap to `Bearer`.

sam: small language notes: Node: `Authorization: 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(`${u}:${p}`).toString('base64')`. Browser: `btoa` only handles latin1; for utf-8 use `btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(str)))`. Deno: `globalThis.btoa` exists in the runtime but same utf-8 caveat applies.

jess: and secret encoding gotchas: k8s secrets are base64 encoded when you `kubectl create secret`. verify you decoded correctly. `echo -n "$KEY" | base64` should match the stored value.

maya: one weirdness: our secret in the UI had surrounding double quotes. trimmed them via `REDWOOD_KEY=${REDWOOD_KEY%"}` in the worker and auth started working. maybe the web UI escapes?

glen: yeah some UIs store the literal quotes if you paste `"..."`. also watch CRLF — Windows line endings break headers. quick fix: `KEY=$(tr -d '\r' < secretfile)` or in JS `key = key.replace(/\r/g, '')`.

sam: if you suspect an extra colon (empty username) for Basic you'll still get a base64 token but server may reject. quick inspect: `echo -n ":$PASSWORD" | base64` and compare.

maya: switching to Bearer fixed it and trimming CRLF made tests green. thanks y'all. :tada: 

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T09:45:12Z — maya/edge-auth-fix — succeeded in 18s

jess: one last tip — for CI secrets, some runners expose a trailing newline when using `echo "$SECRET" > file`. use `printf '%s' "$SECRET" > file` to avoid that.

maya: saved. will add a tiny note in our platform runbook about Bearer vs Basic examples across runtimes.

glen: nice. if anyone wants a tiny gist with Node/Deno/browser snippets I can paste one here.
